title: Term Life Insurance
summary: Affordable coverage designed to help protect your income, home, and family during the years that matter most.
introduction: Term life insurance provides coverage for a defined period. It can help families prepare for the financial impact of an unexpected death during key earning, parenting, or debt-repayment years.
considerations: Coverage ends when the selected term expires
Premiums and eligibility depend on individual circumstances
A review can help align the term and benefit with your needs

title: Whole Life Insurance
summary: Lifetime protection with guaranteed features and cash value that may support future planning needs.
introduction: Whole life insurance is permanent coverage designed to remain in force when required premiums are paid. Policies may build cash value and are often considered for long-term protection and legacy goals.
considerations: Premiums are generally higher than comparable term coverage
Accessing cash value can reduce policy benefits
Policy guarantees depend on the issuing insurer and contract terms

title: Indexed Universal Life
summary: Flexible permanent life insurance with cash-value interest linked in part to a market index.
introduction: Indexed universal life combines permanent life insurance with flexible features and a cash-value account whose credited interest is tied to an index subject to policy limits and terms.
considerations: Returns are not direct investments in an index
Caps, participation rates, costs, and floors affect outcomes
Policies require ongoing monitoring and appropriate funding

title: Mortgage Protection
summary: Coverage intended to help loved ones manage housing costs if life takes an unexpected turn.
introduction: Mortgage protection planning uses life insurance to help a household address mortgage payments or the outstanding balance after the death of an insured family member.
uses: Helping family members remain in their home
Covering some or all of a mortgage obligation
considerations: Coverage should reflect the mortgage and wider household budget
Beneficiaries decide how life insurance proceeds are used
Existing employer or personal coverage should be reviewed

title: Fixed Index Annuities
summary: Insurance products designed for principal protection and potential interest linked to a market index.
introduction: A fixed index annuity is an insurance contract that may earn interest based partly on an index while protecting contract value from direct market losses, subject to contract terms.
uses: Reducing direct exposure to market downturns
considerations: Surrender periods and charges may apply
Index-linked interest is limited by contract terms
Guarantees rely on the claims-paying ability of the insurer

title: Final Expense
summary: Straightforward coverage intended to help loved ones manage funeral and other end-of-life costs.
introduction: Final expense insurance is typically a smaller permanent life policy designed to provide funds for funeral costs, medical bills, and other final obligations.
uses: Leaving family members a dedicated benefit
considerations: Benefit amounts are usually lower than broader life policies
Cost varies with age, health, and coverage
Existing savings and insurance should be considered together
